## Current checkpoint — complete divisors and the ordinary meeting clock

**Universal Collatz convergence remains open.** This continuation uses three GPT-6.2 Astra research lanes and the refreshed PR197 and PR195 heads. It adds all-word cycle-divisor restrictions, a central finite window containing the full eventual meeting mass, and total-variation comparison of entire ordinary futures after rare residue conditioning.

- Science commit: `a5c0eaa979170ff0ba8f85809cb904e78e657ccd`.
- Current receipt head: `5f160a843750f209ea1251dfb01ea0b23e532fd6`.
- Final tree: `797cc6db7b69261510db054ac37b002770926b13`.
- [Combined proof packet](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a5c0eaa979170ff0ba8f85809cb904e78e657ccd/research/astra-ordinary-boundary-20261124/README.md) · [Frozen sources](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a5c0eaa979170ff0ba8f85809cb904e78e657ccd/research/astra-ordinary-boundary-20261124/SOURCES.json) · [Latest-work connections](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a5c0eaa979170ff0ba8f85809cb904e78e657ccd/research/astra-ordinary-boundary-20261124/LATEST_CONNECTIONS.md).

### Full cycle divisor arithmetic

For every coprime pair of clocks `p,A`, uniformly over all words with `p <= A <= Bp`, the bounded-degree part of the discrepancy mask, with all multiplicities, cancels only an `exp(o(p))` part of the **complete** numerical divisor `2^A - 3^p`. Corvaja–Zannier's Subspace-Theorem gcd result applies after excluding its exceptional subgroups using the valuations at two and three.

A separate effective resultant bound permits changing factors of arbitrary degree: a subproduct of total degree `r` has logarithmic gcd at most `O_B(r + sqrt(p r log p))`. Thus every putative coprime-clock ordinary cycle needs aggregate degree `Omega(p/log p)` among factors of degree greater than any fixed bound. Fourier resultants also exclude arbitrary primitive two-block arrangements in the range `g -> infinity, log g = o(b)`, including composite block counts and unbounded clock gcd.

[Arithmetic proofs and exact scope](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a5c0eaa979170ff0ba8f85809cb904e78e657ccd/research/astra-ordinary-boundary-20261124/arithmetic/README.md).

### The whole eventual collision mass has a finite window

For independent ordinary samples in resolved moving patches, all eventual meetings are captured, up to `o(1)` of total probability, by two possibly different shortcut clocks in

`2 log R / log(4/3) +/- B sqrt(log R log log R)`.

The upper deadline also holds for every coupling of the prescribed marginals, including the actual correlated head pair, with absolute `o(1)` error. With the stated density input, the limiting collision mass is `sum_C delta_C^2`. Fixed-target positivity makes Collatz equivalent to this **finite-window** probability tending to one. Its value has not been proved to be one.

The proof retains original-source marks through geometric first passages to a fixed floor, then treats the finitely many remaining root pairs. The floor is fixed before the large-source limit. [Full meeting theorem](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a5c0eaa979170ff0ba8f85809cb904e78e657ccd/research/astra-ordinary-boundary-20261124/transfer/ALL_EVENTUAL_MEETINGS.md) · [Clock and trace estimates](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a5c0eaa979170ff0ba8f85809cb904e78e657ccd/research/astra-ordinary-boundary-20261124/transfer/MEETING_CLOCKS.md).

### Rare classes retain an explicitly shifted ordinary future

On an individual residue class modulo `q=X^{o(1)}`, the complete ordinary post-clock future is close in total variation to that of an ordinary interval source at an explicit changed scale. The estimate is uniform over arbitrarily late future tests. It mixes over adaptive transcript leaves without a factor for their number.

Fixing the first `h` parities with `p` odd inputs shifts the meeting-window center by `C_* log(3) (p-h/2)`. The explicit all-odd class with `h=floor((log X)^(3/4))` has positive eventual meeting mass but vanishing meeting probability by the unshifted central deadline. [Full ordinary-future comparison](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a5c0eaa979170ff0ba8f85809cb904e78e657ccd/research/astra-ordinary-boundary-20261124/spectral/PHYSICAL_TAILS.md).

Neither arbitrary high-degree denominator cancellation nor the value of the full finite meeting mass has been resolved.

### Main results

1. **Finitely many multiplicatively dependent transitions between local minima across the entire positive integer graph.** A dependent mountain edge x→y with x,y>1 must end at the primitive integer base of x. Its exact equation forces (3/2)^k exponentially close to an integer with threshold (3/4)^k. Mahler leaves finitely many k, one candidate base per k, and the uniform return theorem leaves finitely many sources for each base. Every sufficiently late pair of minima on an escaping positive orbit would therefore be independent. Rank-one nontrivial cycles are excluded using Steiner. The Waring refinement imports the published exclusion of k≤471,600,000; that computation was not rerun. [Proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/ebeec2cda24b1deafff17cb2a9ce6e1bed7d9784/research/astra-closure-20261124/arithmetic/README.md) · [Independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/ebeec2cda24b1deafff17cb2a9ce6e1bed7d9784/research/astra-closure-20261124/transfer/REVIEW_ARITHMETIC.md)

2. **Uniform arbitrary-run coset-return counts and a gcd estimate at every mountain.** The number of ordinary sources in one prescribed multiplicative coset that reach another after h mountains is bounded solely by h and the two ranks. All odd/even run lengths and prime supports are unrestricted. The complete signed carry has no proper zero subsum at high entry valleys; first-small-valley splitting covers the rest. ESS applies at joint rank r₀+r₁+2h. Separately Evertse's fixed-prime corollary gives gcd(x,y)≤sqrt(y)x^{o(1)} on every edge. Positive-density selections of minima must have rank ≫log N. No contrary global rank upper bound is assumed. [Proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/ebeec2cda24b1deafff17cb2a9ce6e1bed7d9784/research/astra-closure-20261124/arithmetic/README.md)

3. **Physical repayment bounds with unlimited continuation.** For targets q having a smaller-scale ancestor z≤Kq with a prescribed prefix family W, the actual relative odd density exists and is at most CK Σ_{a∈W}2^{−sum(a)}. The proof controls all late visits, including cycles and overlapping paths. A finite-cutoff estimate is uniform even for changing W. Combined with the new physical first-root marginal, prefix families of binary mass at most d^{−2} occupy only summably small mass on either actual stopped head arm at a sufficiently large polylogarithmic floor. This estimates successful repayment; it does not yet force discordant pairs into that event. [Repayment](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/ebeec2cda24b1deafff17cb2a9ce6e1bed7d9784/research/astra-closure-20261124/descent/REPAYMENT.md) · [Finite-cutoff and actual-source combination](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/ebeec2cda24b1deafff17cb2a9ce6e1bed7d9784/research/astra-closure-20261124/transfer/REVIEW_DESCENT.md)

4. **Sharp literal root discrepancy and strongly dependent stopped pairs.** At every fixed power barrier R^α with log₂sqrt(3)<α<1, unequal actual head/parent first roots number Θ(R/sqrt(j)). At polylogarithmic barriers the stopped values uniquely decode their clock/count differences. On a retained population of fraction p, their true joint law has total-variation distance at least 1−O(d(log d)^3/(pM)) from the product of its own marginals. The proof retains original multiplicities. Review repaired the timely-population normalization, with an explicit counterexample to the unqualified version. [Proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/ebeec2cda24b1deafff17cb2a9ce6e1bed7d9784/research/astra-closure-20261124/transfer/HEAD_ROOTS.md) · [Independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/ebeec2cda24b1deafff17cb2a9ce6e1bed7d9784/research/astra-closure-20261124/arithmetic/REVIEW_HEAD_ROOTS.md)

5. **Post-descent return control and a precise crossing-direction boundary.** Under the named relative-landing and barrier inputs, rebounds above Y^{1.004} before first reaching K have error O_A((log K)^{−A}+Y^{1.001}/R+Y^{−γ}). The bounded all-future contribution tends to zero; escaping mass remains. A new same-source counterfamily has summable first-downward probabilities but nonsummable last-upward probabilities, entirely on trajectories that reach one. A permanent departure with no return is a separate event. [Returns](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/ebeec2cda24b1deafff17cb2a9ce6e1bed7d9784/research/astra-closure-20261124/transfer/RETURNS.md) · [Crossings](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/ebeec2cda24b1deafff17cb2a9ce6e1bed7d9784/research/astra-closure-20261124/boundary/CROSSINGS.md) · [Independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/ebeec2cda24b1deafff17cb2a9ce6e1bed7d9784/research/astra-closure-20261124/transfer/REVIEW_BOUNDARY.md)
